title: Attention by Synchronization in Coupled Oscillator Networks
abstract: arXiv:2606.12059v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We address transformer attention on energy-constrained physical substrates. Softmax attention requires exponentiation and global reduction, operations with high energy cost on von Neumann hardware and no natural physical analog. We show that Kuramoto synchronization dynamics (which arise in electrical, mechanical, superconducting, and charge-density-wave oscillator arrays, among other physical systems) implement a well-defined attention operation. The resulting mechanism, \emph{fixed-query oscillator attention}, replaces softmax's arithmetic with the equilibration of a gradient flow on the sphere: queries are learned anchors fixed on the sphere, and free oscillators evolve under Kuramoto--Lohe dynamics until they settle at positions encoding attention weights via cosine similarity. translated_title: 耦合振子网络中的同步注意力机制
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在能量受限物理基底上实现Transformer注意力机制的问题。软最大注意力需要指数运算和全局归约，这些操作在冯·诺依曼硬件上能耗很高，且没有天然的物理类比。我们证明Kuramoto同步动力学（存在于电学、机械、超导和电荷密度波振子阵列等多种物理系统中）可以实现一种明确的注意力操作。由此产生的机制——固定查询振子注意力——用球面上梯度流的平衡过程取代了softmax的算术运算：查询是固定在球面上的可学习锚点，自由振子在Kuramoto-Lohe动力学下演化，直至稳定在通过余弦相似度编码注意力权重的位置。由于计算本质是平衡过程，因此无需全局指数归一化。该不动点被证明是唯一的，且从……具有全局吸引性。
tldr: 该论文提出利用Kuramoto振子同步动力学实现注意力机制，将softmax计算替换为物理系统中的能量平衡过程，从而在能量受限的物理硬件上实现低能耗的Transformer注意力运算。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that Kuramoto synchronization dynamics in coupled oscillator networks can implement attention operations by replacing softmax computation with physical equilibration on the sphere, enabling energy-efficient transformer attention on physical substrates.
